title: Flux Clamacitor 2.0: calcium carbonate removal mass balances and population estimates for invasive bivalves
description: Code and data accompanying Hartland et al. (2026), Environmental Science & Technology 60 (38), 27204−27214, and its Addition and Correction. Version 2.0 moves the mass-balance and population calculations into a Python package with two settings: legacy, which reproduces the published values, and correction, which gives the corrected values (Ca as the median of the filtered and unfiltered ICP-MS replicates, and a shell bulk density of 0.632 g cm−3 from corrected specimen weighings). Includes the replicate ICP-MS data, the corrected specimen measurements, scripts to redraw Figures 3 and 4 and Table 1, input templates for other lakes and a test suite.
